notes.title: Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, space warriors![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466540/302603017238831f8513f15b47eefba9b6f1ef31.jpg[/img]

We are excited to announce that Gimme Space Battle is now available in Early Access on Steam! 🎉

Get ready to experience a [b][u]new game mode[/u][/b] and finally get access to [b][u]all the spacecrafts[/u][/b] in the game!

Don’t forget to join us and help shape the game with your feedback. Your support means the universe to us! 🌌

[h3]👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447820/Gimme_Space_Battle/][u]Buy the game now and let the battle begin![/u][/url][/h3]
